Frontier Sans is a renamed, static, subset derivative of Noto Sans SC.
Original font source: https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/notosanssc
Copyright and licensing: see NotoSansSC-OFL.txt (SIL Open Font License 1.1).
The original font remains available under its original name.

All game geometry and synthesized audio in Assets/Scripts are original procedural work for this prototype.
Unity and Universal Render Pipeline remain subject to their own licenses.
